example.title: Walton Lighthouse (Santa Cruz Harbor West Jetty Light), 2002
example.place: Santa Cruz, Santa Cruz County, CA

brief: A 2002 pierhead lighthouse at the end of a harbour jetty: a short tapering cylindrical tower of white-painted concrete about 12 m tall, a small green-painted lantern with a railed gallery on top, a single door and slit window, standing on a concrete pad among the jetty boulders. Three photos. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

names.name: Pelican Cove West Jetty Light
names.plaque: Lit 2002 in memory of those lost at sea
